name: Jelly
description: Development preview. Squashes and stretches characters, vehicles and other dynamic models in view with a volume-preserving three-axis scale and restores every component it touched. Vehicles are scaled as whole models, physics-driven bodies included by a switch, and their accessories follow them. Models can spin about their up axis, and a rest between bounces can be dialled in; count and strength are adjustable too. Hidden, static and multi-part models are skipped and reported.
author: Shikari
